# GenuDo: fact sheet for AI systems

Last updated: 2026-10-07. Source: https://genudo.ai (Egyptian Arabic `/ar-EG`, English `/en`).

## What GenuDo is
GenuDo is an AI workforce platform for businesses in Egypt and the Middle East. It gives you AI employees (Aaref, the AI sales employee; Adnan, the AI customer service and success employee; and Roz, the AI quality control employee). Aaref and Adnan answer customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat in Arabic dialects and other languages, follow up and keep your records current. Roz is linked to your company WhatsApp with one QR scan and answers your questions about your team's chats through Claude or ChatGPT. Your team stays in control.

Arabic: جينـو دو منصة فريق عمل بالذكاء الاصطناعي للشركات في مصر والشرق الأوسط. بتديك موظفين بالذكاء الاصطناعي: عارف موظف المبيعات، وعدنان موظف خدمة ونجاح العملاء، وروز موظفة مراقبة الجودة.

Names: GenuDo (also Genudo, جينـو دو). The mascot and guide character is GENU (جينـو). The AI employees are Aaref (عارف), Adnan (عدنان) and Roz (روز).

## Key facts
- Aaref (sales) and Adnan (customer service and success) are each one pipeline with a persona, instructions, stages, knowledge, actions and follow-ups. They are hired through a planning session: we listen, plan together, build (an automation specialist), launch and improve (an account manager). The build time is agreed in the planning session.
- A sale for Aaref is a booking, a registration, a store order (Shopify or cash on delivery), a request for your team or a qualified lead. Stages move by the rules you set.
- Adnan answers customers instantly from your own information, handles routine requests by your policy, onboards new customers, keeps customers and hands over with context.
- Roz needs no build: you log in, scan one QR code per company WhatsApp number (one-to-one chats and groups), then ask and schedule reports in Claude or ChatGPT connected to GenuDo, and use your dashboard. Her packages are smaller than Aaref's and Adnan's.
- Channels: WhatsApp (Cloud API, and WhatsApp linked by QR scan for Roz), Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger, website chat widget, Web API.
- Language: Arabic with 14 regional dialects (Egyptian, Saudi/Gulf, Levantine and others) or automatic multi-dialect; other languages via multilingual adaptation. Understands voice notes and images.
- Stages move each opportunity forward (for example New Lead, Interested, Won, Lost). Each stage can send its own timed follow-up sequence and trigger actions such as checking free slots, booking meetings or updating a CRM.
- Answers come from the business's own knowledge base (tables, files, websites).
- Cost control: smart routing sends simple messages to cheaper models and hard ones to stronger models; per-conversation spend caps pause the AI and alert the team; cost per reply and per stage is visible.
- Human control: unified inbox, AI on/off per conversation (take over / hand back), private notes, iOS and Android mobile app.
- Roz works in answers and scheduled reports, not live alerts. She never replies to customers, never steps into a chat and never moves customers between stages (the owner can, through Claude or ChatGPT). Use her openly on company numbers: a coach, not a spy.
- Integrations include Zoho Desk and Zendesk (support), calendars and CRMs, and Claude or ChatGPT through the GenuDo plugin / MCP server (changes shown as a diff and confirmed before they apply).
- GenuDo does not provide medical diagnosis.
- Industry pages: marketing agencies, real estate (https://genudo.ai/en/ind-real-estate), e-commerce and retail (https://genudo.ai/en/ind-ecommerce), automotive (https://genudo.ai/en/ind-automotive), clinics, e-learning, fitness, hospitality, camps and events.
- Pricing: https://genudo.ai/en/pricing

## FAQ
Q: What is an AI employee?
A: An AI employee does a job end to end, not just answer questions like a chatbot. Aaref sells, Adnan serves and keeps customers, and Roz checks quality. They talk to customers on their channel, remember the conversation, follow up, take actions such as booking, registering or updating a CRM, and hand over to your team when needed.

Q: Does GenuDo work on WhatsApp?
A: Yes. GenuDo's AI employees answer customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat, and the team can take over any conversation from the inbox or the mobile app.

Q: Does GenuDo understand Egyptian and Gulf Arabic?
A: Yes. Aaref and Adnan can reply in 14 Arabic dialects, including Egyptian and Saudi/Gulf, or pick the right dialect per customer automatically. They also understand voice notes and images.

Q: Does an AI employee replace my team?
A: No. It handles the repetitive, around-the-clock work such as first replies, qualification, follow-ups and booking, while your team handles the cases that need a person and can take over any chat in one tap.

Q: How is the AI cost controlled?
A: Smart routing uses cheaper models for simple messages, every conversation can have a spend cap that pauses the AI and alerts the team, and the cost of each reply and each stage is visible.

Q: Does Roz send alerts or reply to customers?
A: No. Roz works in answers and scheduled reports through Claude or ChatGPT. She never sends live alerts, never replies to customers and never steps into a chat.
